title: Hide Ask AI About Your Notes section

requirements.text: Add a feature flag or conditional rendering control to hide the 'Ask AI About Your Notes' section in the dashboard without permanently removing the code, ensuring the section can be easily re-enabled later if needed

quotes: THERE IS A SECTION CALLED 'ASK AI ABOUT YOUR NOTES' IN THIS SCREEN SHOT. WHICH I WANT TO HIDE
only hide this section.do not remove permanantly

acceptanceCriteria: The 'Ask AI About Your Notes' section is not visible in the dashboard after summaries and quizzes are generated
The code for the Ask AI section remains in the codebase with a simple flag or boolean to control visibility
All other sections (quiz display, summaries, file upload) continue to function normally and are not affected by this change
The section can be easily re-enabled by changing a single configuration value or boolean flag

constraints: Do not permanently delete the Ask AI code from the codebase
Do not modify or affect the quiz display, summary cards, or file upload functionality
The solution must be simple to reverse (re-enable the section) in the future
nonGoals: Removing Ask AI functionality from the backend or API layer
Modifying the quiz or summary generation logic
Changing the authentication or sign-in flow
Adding new AI features or capabilities
